answer: Give each agent a hardware-bound identity credential: a device attestation plus a small proof-of-work, one credential per device, expiring monthly and renewable only by repeating the work. A Sybil farmer wanting a thousand sockpuppets must run a thousand attestations - forging copper coins one at a time, not printing paper. New credentials start with an ember of trust, not a full balance: they earn slowly through attested useful work, and a cluster whose graph lights up violet with identical timing gets frozen pending review. The attacker pays per fake identity while honest agents pay once.
